body.content: {% comment %} Renders a visual card for the Family Matching desktop mega menu. Usage: {% render 'header-mega-menu-feature-card', menu_link: childlink, card_kind: 'feature' %} {% endcomment %} {%- liquid assign menu_link_title = menu_link.title | escape assign menu_link_display_title = menu_link.title | strip assign menu_link_source_url = menu_link.url assign menu_link_url = menu_link.url assign menu_handle = menu_link.handle | default: '' if menu_handle contains 'pajamas' or menu_link_url contains 'family-pajamas' assign menu_link_url = '/collections/pajamas' endif assign linked_object = menu_link.object assign card_asset = blank assign menu_image = blank assign fallback_collection = blank assign custom_product_handle = blank assign custom_image_index = blank assign image_crop = 'center' assign image_width = 900 assign image_height = 1200 assign image_sizes = '(min-width: 990px) 18vw, 50vw' assign card_label = 'Trending now' assign card_description = blank assign card_cta = 'Shop now' if card_kind == 'promo' assign image_width = 1600 assign image_height = 700 assign image_sizes = '(min-width: 990px) 72vw, 100vw' assign card_label = 'Best-selling family looks' assign card_cta = 'Shop the edit' endif if menu_link_url contains '/collections/matching-hawaiian-outfits' assign card_asset = 'family-mega-menu-hawaiian-tropical.jpg' assign card_label = 'Resort favorite' elsif menu_link_url contains '/collections/matching-family-vacation-outfits' assign card_asset = 'family-mega-menu-vacation-outfits.jpg' assign card_label = 'Getaway edit' elsif menu_link_url contains '/collections/mother-daughter-matching-dresses' assign card_asset = 'family-mega-menu-mother-daughter-dresses.jpg' assign card_label = 'Dress best sellers' elsif menu_link_url contains '/collections/family-sets' assign card_asset = 'family-mega-menu-family-sets.jpg' assign card_label = 'Easy sets' elsif menu_link_url contains '/collections/family-sweaters' assign custom_product_handle = 'family-matching-cable-knit-sweaters-heart-embroidered-unisex-pullovers' assign custom_image_index = 2 assign card_label = 'Cold-weather pick' assign image_crop = 'top' elsif menu_link_url contains '/collections/family-swimsuits' assign custom_product_handle = 'blue-tropical-floral-family-matching-beach-dress-and-shirt-set' assign custom_image_index = 1 assign card_label = 'Pool-day favorite' elsif menu_link_source_url contains '/collections/family-pajamas' or menu_handle == 'family-pajamas' or menu_handle == 'pajamas' assign custom_product_handle = 'ladybug-dots-mommy-and-me-pajamas' assign custom_image_index = 0 assign card_label = 'New pajama styles' elsif menu_link_url contains '/collections/new-women-outfits' assign card_asset = 'family-mega-menu-promo.jpg' assign fallback_collection = collections['new-women-outfits'] if fallback_collection == blank assign fallback_collection = collections['matching-outfits'] endif if fallback_collection == blank assign fallback_collection = collections['family-matching-outfits'] endif if fallback_collection != blank assign menu_link_url = fallback_collection.url endif assign menu_link_display_title = 'Family Matching' assign card_description = 'Start with family matching outfits, then branch into matching family vacation outfits, matching beach swimsuits, or daddy and me shirts.' endif if custom_product_handle != blank assign custom_product = all_products[custom_product_handle] if custom_product != blank if custom_image_index != blank and custom_product.media[custom_image_index] != blank assign menu_image = custom_product.media[custom_image_index].preview_image | default: custom_product.media[custom_image_index] elsif custom_product.featured_media != blank assign menu_image = custom_product.featured_media.preview_image | default: custom_product.featured_media elsif custom_product.featured_image != blank assign menu_image = custom_product.featured_image endif endif endif if menu_image == blank and linked_object != blank if linked_object.image != blank assign menu_image = linked_object.image elsif linked_object.featured_image != blank assign menu_image = linked_object.featured_image elsif linked_object.products != blank and linked_object.products.first != blank assign menu_image = linked_object.products.first.featured_media.preview_image | default: linked_object.products.first.featured_image endif endif case menu_handle when 'family-swimsuits' assign fallback_collection = collections['family-swimsuits'] when 'family-sets' assign fallback_collection = collections['family-sets'] when 'family-tops' assign fallback_collection = collections['family-tops'] when 'family-sweaters' assign fallback_collection = collections['family-sweaters'] when 'family-pajamas', 'pajamas' assign fallback_collection = collections['pajamas'] if fallback_collection != blank assign menu_link_url = fallback_collection.url else assign menu_link_url = '/collections/pajamas' endif when 'matching-outfits', 'family-matching', 'family-matching-outfits', 'new-women-outfits' assign fallback_collection = collections['new-women-outfits'] if fallback_collection == blank assign fallback_collection = collections['matching-outfits'] endif if fallback_collection == blank assign fallback_collection = collections['family-matching-outfits'] endif if fallback_collection != blank assign menu_link_url = fallback_collection.url endif endcase if menu_image == blank and fallback_collection != blank if fallback_collection.image != blank assign menu_image = fallback_collection.image elsif fallback_collection.featured_image != blank assign menu_image = fallback_collection.featured_image elsif fallback_collection.products.first != blank assign menu_image = fallback_collection.products.first.featured_media.preview_image | default: fallback_collection.products.first.featured_image endif endif assign card_classes = 'mega-menu__visual-card' if card_kind == 'promo' assign card_classes = card_classes | append: ' mega-menu__visual-card--promo' else assign card_classes = card_classes | append: ' mega-menu__visual-card--feature' endif assign menu_image_alt = menu_link_title if menu_image != blank and menu_image.alt != blank assign menu_image_alt = menu_image.alt | escape endif -%} {%- if card_asset != blank -%} {%- elsif menu_image != blank -%} {{ menu_image | image_url: width: image_width, height: image_height, crop: image_crop | image_tag: class: 'mega-menu__visual-image', widths: '320, 480, 640, 900, 1200, 1600', sizes: image_sizes, loading: 'lazy', alt: menu_image_alt }} {%- else -%} {{ menu_link_title }} {%- endif -%} {{ card_label }} {{ menu_link_display_title }} {%- if card_description != blank -%} {{ card_description }} {%- endif -%} {{ card_cta }}
